package domain

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"strings"
	"time"
	"unicode/utf8"
)

const (
	TeacherContextSummarySchemaCode    = "teacher.context-summary.v1"
	TeacherContextSummaryPolicyVersion = "teacher-context-summary-policy-v1"

	TeacherContextMaximumMessages        = 50
	TeacherContextMaximumExcerptRunes    = 2000
	TeacherContextMaximumExcerptBytes    = 64 << 10
	TeacherContextMaximumBytes           = 160 << 10
	TeacherContextMaximumRunes           = 50000
	TeacherResponseVariablesMaximumBytes = 1 << 20
	TeacherResponseVariablesMaximumRunes = 262144
)

var (
	ErrInvalidTeacherContextSummary  = errors.New("invalid teacher context summary")
	ErrTeacherContextSummaryConflict = errors.New("teacher context summary conflict")
	ErrTeacherContextSourceTooLarge  = errors.New("teacher context source too large")
)

// TeacherContextScope identifies one Teacher-owned provisional memory. It is
// intentionally narrower than a student: summaries never cross a Dialog or
// educational context boundary.
type TeacherContextScope struct {
	StudentID         string
	PersonalTeacherID string
	DialogID          string
	ContextType       LearningContextType
	ContextID         string
}

func NewTeacherContextScope(input TeacherContextScope) (TeacherContextScope, error) {
	input.StudentID = strings.TrimSpace(input.StudentID)
	input.PersonalTeacherID = strings.TrimSpace(input.PersonalTeacherID)
	input.DialogID = strings.TrimSpace(input.DialogID)
	input.ContextID = strings.TrimSpace(input.ContextID)
	if !validUUID(input.StudentID) || !validUUID(input.PersonalTeacherID) || !validUUID(input.DialogID) ||
		!validTeacherDialogBindingContext(input.ContextType, input.ContextID) {
		return TeacherContextScope{}, ErrInvalidTeacherContextSummary
	}
	return input, nil
}

type TeacherContextSummaryPayload struct {
	Schema                 string   `json:"schema"`
	Summary                string   `json:"summary"`
	UnderstoodObservations []string `json:"understood_observations"`
	OpenDifficulties       []string `json:"open_difficulties"`
	AssistanceObservations []string `json:"assistance_observations"`
	NextFocus              []string `json:"next_focus"`
}

func NormalizeTeacherContextSummaryPayload(input TeacherContextSummaryPayload) (TeacherContextSummaryPayload, error) {
	input.Schema = strings.TrimSpace(input.Schema)
	input.Summary = strings.TrimSpace(input.Summary)
	if input.Schema != TeacherContextSummarySchemaCode || !validBoundedSummaryText(input.Summary, 4000) ||
		input.UnderstoodObservations == nil || input.OpenDifficulties == nil ||
		input.AssistanceObservations == nil || input.NextFocus == nil {
		return TeacherContextSummaryPayload{}, ErrInvalidTeacherContextSummary
	}
	var err error
	if input.UnderstoodObservations, err = normalizeSummaryList(input.UnderstoodObservations); err != nil {
		return TeacherContextSummaryPayload{}, err
	}
	if input.OpenDifficulties, err = normalizeSummaryList(input.OpenDifficulties); err != nil {
		return TeacherContextSummaryPayload{}, err
	}
	if input.AssistanceObservations, err = normalizeSummaryList(input.AssistanceObservations); err != nil {
		return TeacherContextSummaryPayload{}, err
	}
	if input.NextFocus, err = normalizeSummaryList(input.NextFocus); err != nil {
		return TeacherContextSummaryPayload{}, err
	}
	return input, nil
}

type TeacherContextSummary struct {
	Scope                  TeacherContextScope
	CoveredFromSequence    int64
	CoveredThroughSequence int64
	DigestFromSequence     int64
	DigestThroughSequence  int64
	DigestEventSequence    int64
	SourceDigest           string
	Payload                TeacherContextSummaryPayload
	SchemaCode             string
	PolicyVersion          string
	Revision               int64
	CreatedAt              time.Time
	UpdatedAt              time.Time
}

func NormalizeTeacherContextSummary(input TeacherContextSummary) (TeacherContextSummary, error) {
	scope, err := NewTeacherContextScope(input.Scope)
	if err != nil {
		return TeacherContextSummary{}, err
	}
	payload, err := NormalizeTeacherContextSummaryPayload(input.Payload)
	if err != nil {
		return TeacherContextSummary{}, err
	}
	input.SchemaCode = strings.TrimSpace(input.SchemaCode)
	input.PolicyVersion = strings.TrimSpace(input.PolicyVersion)
	input.SourceDigest = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(input.SourceDigest))
	input.CreatedAt = input.CreatedAt.UTC()
	input.UpdatedAt = input.UpdatedAt.UTC()
	if input.CoveredFromSequence < 1 || input.CoveredThroughSequence < input.CoveredFromSequence ||
		input.DigestFromSequence < input.CoveredFromSequence || input.DigestThroughSequence < input.DigestFromSequence ||
		input.DigestThroughSequence > input.CoveredThroughSequence || input.DigestEventSequence < input.DigestThroughSequence ||
		len(input.SourceDigest) != 64 || !isLowerHex(input.SourceDigest) ||
		input.SchemaCode != TeacherContextSummarySchemaCode || input.PolicyVersion != TeacherContextSummaryPolicyVersion ||
		input.Revision < 0 || input.CreatedAt.IsZero() || input.UpdatedAt.IsZero() || input.UpdatedAt.Before(input.CreatedAt) {
		return TeacherContextSummary{}, ErrInvalidTeacherContextSummary
	}
	encoded, err := json.Marshal(payload)
	if err != nil || len(encoded) > 128<<10 {
		return TeacherContextSummary{}, ErrInvalidTeacherContextSummary
	}
	input.Scope = scope
	input.Payload = payload
	return input, nil
}

type TeacherContextSummaryUpdate struct {
	Summary                 TeacherContextSummary
	ExpectedThroughSequence int64
	NewFromSequence         int64
}

func NormalizeTeacherContextSummaryUpdate(input TeacherContextSummaryUpdate) (TeacherContextSummaryUpdate, error) {
	summary, err := NormalizeTeacherContextSummary(input.Summary)
	if err != nil || input.ExpectedThroughSequence < 0 || input.NewFromSequence < 1 ||
		(input.ExpectedThroughSequence == 0 && summary.CoveredFromSequence != input.NewFromSequence) ||
		(input.ExpectedThroughSequence > 0 && (summary.CoveredFromSequence > input.ExpectedThroughSequence || input.NewFromSequence <= input.ExpectedThroughSequence)) ||
		input.NewFromSequence > summary.CoveredThroughSequence {
		return TeacherContextSummaryUpdate{}, ErrInvalidTeacherContextSummary
	}
	input.Summary = summary
	return input, nil
}

type TeacherContextMessage struct {
	AuthorType      DialogMessageAuthorType `json:"author_type"`
	Body            string                  `json:"body"`
	MessageSequence int64                   `json:"message_sequence"`
	IsSource        bool                    `json:"is_source"`
}

type TeacherContextSummarizationRequest struct {
	IdempotencyKey string
	LanguageCode   string
	Scope          TeacherContextScope
	PriorSummary   *TeacherContextSummaryPayload
	Messages       []TeacherContextMessage
}

func NormalizeTeacherContextSummarizationRequest(input TeacherContextSummarizationRequest) (TeacherContextSummarizationRequest, error) {
	scope, err := NewTeacherContextScope(input.Scope)
	input.IdempotencyKey = strings.TrimSpace(input.IdempotencyKey)
	input.LanguageCode = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(input.LanguageCode))
	if err != nil || !validUUID(input.IdempotencyKey) || (input.LanguageCode != "ru" && input.LanguageCode != "en") ||
		len(input.Messages) < 1 || len(input.Messages) > TeacherContextMaximumMessages {
		return TeacherContextSummarizationRequest{}, ErrInvalidTeacherContextSummary
	}
	var totalBytes int
	previous := int64(0)
	for index := range input.Messages {
		message := &input.Messages[index]
		if message.IsSource || (message.AuthorType != DialogMessageAuthorUser && message.AuthorType != DialogMessageAuthorPersonalTeacher) ||
			message.MessageSequence <= previous || strings.TrimSpace(message.Body) == "" || !utf8.ValidString(message.Body) ||
			utf8.RuneCountInString(message.Body) > TeacherContextMaximumExcerptRunes {
			return TeacherContextSummarizationRequest{}, ErrInvalidTeacherContextSummary
		}
		totalBytes += len(message.Body)
		previous = message.MessageSequence
	}
	if totalBytes > TeacherContextMaximumExcerptBytes {
		return TeacherContextSummarizationRequest{}, ErrInvalidTeacherContextSummary
	}
	if input.PriorSummary != nil {
		prior, priorErr := NormalizeTeacherContextSummaryPayload(*input.PriorSummary)
		if priorErr != nil {
			return TeacherContextSummarizationRequest{}, priorErr
		}
		input.PriorSummary = &prior
	}
	input.Scope = scope
	return input, nil
}

type TeacherContextSummaryProjection struct {
	Schema                 string                       `json:"schema"`
	PolicyVersion          string                       `json:"policy_version"`
	CoveredFromSequence    int64                        `json:"covered_from_sequence"`
	CoveredThroughSequence int64                        `json:"covered_through_sequence"`
	Observations           TeacherContextSummaryPayload `json:"observations"`
}

type TeacherPromptDialogContext struct {
	Messages           []TeacherContextMessage          `json:"messages"`
	ProvisionalSummary *TeacherContextSummaryProjection `json:"provisional_summary,omitempty"`
}

func NormalizeTeacherPromptDialogContext(input TeacherPromptDialogContext, sourceID string, dialog DialogRequestContext) (TeacherPromptDialogContext, error) {
	if len(input.Messages) < 1 || len(input.Messages) > TeacherContextMaximumMessages {
		return TeacherPromptDialogContext{}, ErrInvalidTeacherGeneration
	}
	var excerptBytes int
	previous := int64(0)
	sourceSequence := dialog.Messages[len(dialog.Messages)-1].MessageSequence
	for index := range input.Messages {
		message := &input.Messages[index]
		if (message.AuthorType != DialogMessageAuthorUser && message.AuthorType != DialogMessageAuthorPersonalTeacher) ||
			message.MessageSequence <= previous || strings.TrimSpace(message.Body) == "" || !utf8.ValidString(message.Body) ||
			utf8.RuneCountInString(message.Body) > TeacherContextMaximumExcerptRunes {
			return TeacherPromptDialogContext{}, ErrInvalidTeacherGeneration
		}
		excerptBytes += len(message.Body)
		if message.IsSource {
			if message.MessageSequence != sourceSequence || message.Body != dialog.Messages[len(dialog.Messages)-1].Body {
				return TeacherPromptDialogContext{}, ErrInvalidTeacherGeneration
			}
		}
		previous = message.MessageSequence
	}
	last := input.Messages[len(input.Messages)-1]
	if !last.IsSource || last.MessageSequence != sourceSequence || excerptBytes > TeacherContextMaximumExcerptBytes || !validUUID(sourceID) {
		return TeacherPromptDialogContext{}, ErrInvalidTeacherGeneration
	}
	if input.ProvisionalSummary != nil {
		projection := input.ProvisionalSummary
		payload, err := NormalizeTeacherContextSummaryPayload(projection.Observations)
		if err != nil || projection.Schema != TeacherContextSummarySchemaCode ||
			projection.PolicyVersion != TeacherContextSummaryPolicyVersion || projection.CoveredFromSequence < 1 ||
			projection.CoveredThroughSequence < projection.CoveredFromSequence || projection.CoveredThroughSequence >= sourceSequence {
			return TeacherPromptDialogContext{}, ErrInvalidTeacherGeneration
		}
		projection.Observations = payload
	}
	encoded, err := json.Marshal(input)
	if err != nil || len(encoded) > TeacherContextMaximumBytes || utf8.RuneCount(encoded) > TeacherContextMaximumRunes {
		return TeacherPromptDialogContext{}, ErrInvalidTeacherGeneration
	}
	return input, nil
}

func normalizeSummaryList(values []string) ([]string, error) {
	if len(values) > 8 {
		return nil, ErrInvalidTeacherContextSummary
	}
	result := make([]string, len(values))
	for index, value := range values {
		value = strings.TrimSpace(value)
		if !validBoundedSummaryText(value, 500) {
			return nil, ErrInvalidTeacherContextSummary
		}
		result[index] = value
	}
	return result, nil
}

func validBoundedSummaryText(value string, maximum int) bool {
	return value != "" && utf8.ValidString(value) && utf8.RuneCountInString(value) <= maximum
}

func isLowerHex(value string) bool {
	for _, symbol := range value {
		if (symbol < '0' || symbol > '9') && (symbol < 'a' || symbol > 'f') {
			return false
		}
	}
	return true
}
